Based on my chemistry knowledge, when metals like aluminum and zinc react with strong bases (like sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide), they typically undergo a redox reaction where the metal is oxidized and water is reduced, producing hydrogen gas. The reaction can be represented as:

2Al + 2NaOH + 6H₂O → 2Na[Al(OH)₄] + 3H₂
or
Zn + 2NaOH + 2H₂O → Na₂[Zn(OH)₄] + H₂

A. Carbon dioxide - Not produced in these reactions
B. Hydrogen - Produced when metals like Al and Zn react with strong bases

D. Oxygen - Not produced in these reactions
